Report one saved telemetry metric as a budget's measurement.

`report-command-seconds` runs from cold install to the end of the main result upload, so it ends before the comment post. `report-github-api-requests-per-run` counts every request made through gh, retries and pages included: budget commands such as CI-time reads, the workflow lookup, the history and merged-run reads and the delivery. A budget reading it during the job sees the count before the post, whose requests the saved file then adds.

Usage: onebudgetspec-github-action telemetry [OPTIONS] --metric <METRIC> --input <INPUT>

Options:
      --metric <METRIC>
          The metric to report, a key of the file's `metrics`

      --input <INPUT>
          The saved telemetry file, relative to the budgets file's directory under a check

      --label <LABEL>
          The label the file must carry, proving it is this job's own telemetry
          
          [default: ci-report]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
